sources.cadence: Updated daily; approvals can lag occurrence.

sources.name: Florissant Police public crime map

sources.name: County municipal investigations and Highway Patrol crash reporting
sources.cadence: Daily editorial review of dated, attributable reports; not a comprehensive incident feed.

sources.name: Chesterfield Police daily crime bulletins
sources.cadence: Weekday daily bulletins reviewed during maintenance; publication and approval lag apply.
sources.coverage: Selected official Chesterfield bulletins supplement the weekly County feed. Seven reviewed cases dated November 9–12 are mapped. A juvenile case and a case with a broad unverified street range were omitted. Not complete municipal coverage.
sources.sourceMethod: AI review of official linked PDFs; not an unattended PDF feed.

sources.name: City investigations from attributed local reporting
sources.cadence: Daily review of new and changed local reports.
sources.coverage: Selected City cases and source corrections supplement SLMPD public reports; not comprehensive coverage.

coverageNote: City and County are always shown together. City and Florissant public maps supplement County and participating municipal feeds, which update weekly. Chesterfield daily bulletins, reviewed municipal investigations and Highway Patrol reporting add newer County cases. Agency exclusions and approval delays remain. These are reported incidents, not a complete regional census or safety ranking. Locations are approximate; unknown outcomes are not zero.
